claim_verdicts.evidence: inside-flutter.md: 'If Flutter had a strict build-then-layout-then-paint pipeline, [...] the layout phase is too late to build the widgets necessary to fill the space. Flutter solves this problem by interleaving the build and layout phases of the pipeline.' The three phases are right, but a strict whole-tree 'build first, then layout' is not; the lesson's own ListView.builder rows are built during layout. Per piece of UI the order build -> layout -> paint holds.
claim_verdicts.source: refs/flutter-website/sites/docs/src/content/resources/inside-flutter.md ('Building widgets on demand'); resources/architectural-overview.md ('Rendering and layout')
claim_verdicts.suggested_text: Flutter turns widgets into pixels in three phases, and each piece of the screen goes through them in order: build describes what should exist, layout gives it a size and a position, paint draws it.

claim_verdicts.evidence: constraints.md: 'Constraints go down. Sizes go up. Parent sets position.' ... 'A widget gets its own constraints from its parent.' ... 'the widget positions its children'. architectural-overview.md: 'In determining its size, the child must respect the constraints given to it by its parent. Children respond by passing up a size to their parent object within the constraints the parent established.'

constraints.md Example 3: 'The screen forces the Center to be exactly the same size as the screen, so the Center fills the screen. The Center tells the Container that it can be any size it wants, but not bigger than the screen.' SDK 3.47.2 rendering/shifted_box.dart:480-491 (RenderPositionedBox): child!.layout(constraints.loosen(), ...); size = constraints.constrain(Size(... double.infinity ...)); alignChild(); shrink-wrap only when max is infinite.

git -C examples/don-hang show stage-1:DonHang.App/lib/screens/product_list_screen.dart, lines 43-51 and 60-63, match both code blocks character for character: waiting -> 'return const Center(child: CircularProgressIndicator());', hasError -> Center(child: Text('Could not load products: ${snapshot.error}')), ListTile(title: Text(product.name), trailing: Text('${product.priceVnd} đ')).

SDK 3.47.2: rendering/sliver_list.dart:56 'childConstraints = constraints.asBoxConstraints()'; sliver.dart asBoxConstraints for Axis.vertical returns minWidth: crossAxisExtent, maxWidth: crossAxisExtent (tight width). material/list_tile.dart _computeSizes: trailing laid out with loose iconConstraints (sized to content); title gets looseConstraints.tighten(width: tileWidth - titleStart - adjustedTrailingWidth); trailing placed at the end per text direction.

SDK 3.47.2 rendering/view.dart: RenderView 'set configuration' (new view size) calls markNeedsLayout(). material/scaffold.dart:1106-1114: body gets _BodyBoxConstraints(maxWidth: full width, maxHeight: bodyMaxHeight), min 0. Center loosens (shifted_box.dart:484); CircularProgressIndicator default 'BoxConstraints(minWidth: 36.0, minHeight: 36.0)' (progress_indicator.dart:1516), so its size does not follow the window while alignChild() recentres it.

inside-flutter.md: 'a change to an Animation<Color> might trigger only the paint phase rather than both the build and paint phases.' That is conditional ('might', observable animations). A colour change via setState reruns build too; what is skipped is layout (_RenderColoredBox color setter calls only markNeedsPaint(), widgets/basic.dart). 'only painting has to be redone' is too strong.
claim_verdicts.suggested_text: When only a colour changes, no size or position changes, so Flutter does not need to redo layout for it: it paints again using the positions it already has.

claim_verdicts.evidence: Ledger labels this 'opinion' but it is a behaviour claim; it holds. SDK 3.47.2 rendering/binding.dart drawFrame(): 'rootPipelineOwner.flushLayout(); rootPipelineOwner.flushCompositingBits(); rootPipelineOwner.flushPaint();'. architectural-overview.md: 'At the end of this single walk through the tree, every object has a defined size within its parent's constraints and is ready to be painted by calling the paint() method.'
